In this notebook, I will compute TCR phenotype data

TiRP script obtained from [ImmunoGenomics GitHub page](https://github.com/immunogenomics/TiRP)

# Setup

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(alakazam)

source("../../src/tirp/results/TiRP.R")
```

```{r}
tcrs <- read_csv("data/tcr/filtered_contigs_paired_241120.csv")
tcrs
```

# TiRP

```{r}
TiRP.input <- tcrs %>% 
  select(v_gene.TRB, cdr3.TRB) %>% 
  rename(v_gene = v_gene.TRB, cdr3 = cdr3.TRB) %>% 
  mutate(v_gene = as.factor(v_gene)) %>%  # TiRP requires v_gene to be a factor
  as.data.frame  # TiRP won't work as a tibble
TiRP.input
```

```{r}
path_to_results <- "src/tirp/results"
tictoc::tic()
TiRP.output <- TiRP(TiRP.input)
tictoc::toc()
TiRP.output
```

```{r}
write_csv(TiRP.output, "out/tcr/tirp/241120_predictCOL_tirp.csv")
```

# Alakazam


```{r}
tcrs.input <- tcrs %>% 
  mutate(cdr3.len = nchar(cdr3.TRB)) %>% 
  mutate(cdr3mr = ifelse(cdr3.len >= 12 & cdr3.len <= 17, substr(cdr3.TRB, 5, nchar(cdr3.TRB) - 6), NA)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(cdr3mr)) %>% 
  select(cdr3mr) %>% 
  distinct

tcrs.input
```

```{r}
tcrs.scored <- aminoAcidProperties(tcrs.input, seq = "cdr3mr", nt = FALSE)
tcrs.scored
```

```{r}
write_csv(tcrs.scored, "out/tcr/alakazam/cdr3b_mr_alakazam_scored_241120.csv")
```
